Cross is a well-known brand established in 1846, recognized for quality writing instruments.

276712525.description:
Natural Mineral and Fossil Collection
Mixed Specimen Lot with Quartz, Agate, and Orthoceras
Natural Crystal, Polished Stone, and Fossil Matrix
8" x 6" x 4" (Approximate Lot Size)
Multiple Pieces
This diverse geological collection features a prominent quartz crystal cluster as a centerpiece, showcasing natural prismatic terminations and translucent white clarity. The assembly includes a variety of mineral specimens, most notably a polished Orthoceras fossil-a prehistoric nautiloid-exhibiting clear internal chamber structures. The lot also contains vibrant dyed magenta agate slices, a geode half, and an assortment of tumbled gemstones including carnelian, tiger's eye, and amethyst points, offering a comprehensive display of lapidary and natural forms.
Significant quartz cluster featuring multiple distinct crystal points and matrix base
Polished Orthoceras fossil specimen highlighting paleobiological internal anatomy
Selection of carved and tumbled stones including star and angel motifs in various minerals
Condition:
Very good overall condition with typical geological variations. Polished pieces retain a high-gloss finish, and the dyed agate displays vibrant color saturation. The quartz cluster shows minor natural abrasions to some terminations, and the fossil matrix remains stable and well-preserved.
Warehouse Location: Cleveland
